subject: DI03005041

body.en:
Definition

Soap is a sodium or potassium salt of a higher fatty acid; it is an anionic surfactant.

Properties and action / classification

The hydrocarbon tail associates with oily soil and the ionic carboxylate head associates with water. At suitable concentration, aggregates/micelles help disperse and remove soil. Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ in hard water form poorly soluble soaps(scum),reducing cleaning; acidic conditions can form less-soluble free fatty acid. Sodium soaps are usually harder; potassium soaps are generally softer/more soluble.

Applications

Toilet/laundry soaps and suitable cleaning/emulsifying/lubricating formulations; grade, additives and hygiene claims require separate specifications.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Higher fatty acidનું sodium અથવા potassium salt એટલે soap; તે anionic surfactant છે.

ગુણધર્મો,કાર્ય તથા વર્ગીકરણ

Hydrocarbon tail oily soil સાથે અને ionic carboxylate head water સાથે જોડાય છે. યોગ્ય concentrationએ aggregates/micelles soil disperse/remove કરવામાં મદદ કરે છે. Hard waterના Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺થી poorly soluble soaps(scum) બને છે અને cleaning ઘટે છે; acidic mediumમાં free fatty acid બની શકે છે. Sodium soaps સામાન્ય રીતે harder અને potassium soaps softer/more soluble હોય છે.

ઉપયોગો

Toilet/laundry soaps તથા suitable cleaning/emulsifying/lubricating formulationsમાં ઉપયોગ; grade, additives તથા hygiene claims માટે અલગ specifications જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

A synthetic detergent is a cleaning formulation based on surfactants which need not be fatty-acid salts; commercial detergent powder also contains builders and other functional ingredients.

Properties and action / classification

By surfactant charge:anionic(e.g. LAS),cationic, nonionic and amphoteric. The syllabus powder route uses an anionic LAS system. Surfactants lower interfacial tension and disperse soil; builders manage hardness/alkalinity and assist cleaning. LAS forms less hard-water scum than fatty-acid soap, but detergent performance still depends on formulation, water and dosage.

Applications

Laundry, dishwashing, household and industrial cleaning with a formulation designed for the surface and wash conditions. Avoid mixing incompatible cleaners.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Fatty-acid salts હોવું જરૂરી ન હોય એવા surfactants આધારિત cleaning formulation એટલે synthetic detergent; commercial powderમાં builders તથા બીજા functional ingredients પણ હોય છે.

ગુણધર્મો,કાર્ય તથા વર્ગીકરણ

Surfactant charge મુજબ anionic(જેમ કે LAS),cationic, nonionic તથા amphoteric. Syllabus powder route anionic LAS system છે. Surfactants interfacial tension ઘટાડીને soil disperse કરે છે; builders hardness/alkalinity manage કરે છે. LAS fatty-acid soap કરતાં hard-water scum ઓછું બનાવે છે,પરંતુ performance formulation, water તથા dosage પર આધારિત રહે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Surface તથા wash conditions મુજબ laundry, dishwashing, household/industrial cleaningમાં ઉપયોગ. Incompatible cleaners ભેળવવા નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Glycerol, C3H8O3,is propane-1,2,3-triol; glycerin is the commercial name commonly used for glycerol-containing grades.

Properties and action / classification

It is a colourless, viscous, hygroscopic liquid, miscible with water and possessing three hydroxyl groups. Pure material has density about1.26g/cm³ near room temperature. Its low volatility and tendency to degrade at harsh high-temperature conditions favour vacuum purification. Purity, water content, colour and contaminant limits distinguish crude, technical and approved pharmaceutical/food grades.

Applications

Humectant/solvent in approved personal-care, pharmaceutical and food formulations; resins, chemical synthesis and industrial formulations. Crude recovered glycerin is not automatically suitable for ingestion or medical use.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Glycerol, C3H8O3 એટલે propane-1,2,3-triol; glycerol-containing commercial grades માટે glycerin નામ વપરાય છે.

ગુણધર્મો,કાર્ય તથા વર્ગીકરણ

તે colourless, viscous, hygroscopic liquid છે,water સાથે miscible છે અને ત્રણ hydroxyl groups ધરાવે છે. Pure materialની density room temperature નજીક આશરે1.26g/cm³ છે. Low volatility તથા harsh high temperatureએ degradationને લીધે vacuum purification અનુકૂળ છે. Purity, water, colour તથા contaminant limitsથી crude, technical અને approved pharmaceutical/food grades જુદાં પડે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Approved personal-care, pharmaceutical/food formulationsમાં humectant/solvent તથા resins, chemical synthesis/industrial formulationsમાં ઉપયોગ. Crude recovered glycerin આપમેળે ingestion/medical use માટે યોગ્ય નથી.

body.en:
Definition

The continuous-hydrolysis soap route first splits fats into fatty acids and glycerol, then neutralises purified fatty acids with alkali to form soap.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Pretreated fats/oils, water/steam, NaOH solution and permitted finishing additives.

Triglyceride + 3H2O ⇌ glycerol + 3RCOOH; RCOOH + NaOH → RCOONa + H2O.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Fat preparation and continuous splitting—E01–E02

Fats/oils are filtered and conditioned to remove dirt and unsuitable impurities. In the continuous splitting tower, hot water contacts fat under the pressure needed to maintain the intended liquid system. Hydrolysis breaks ester bonds into fatty acids and glycerol. Industrial high-pressure splitting is often described near250°C at several MPa, but actual equipment conditions are design-specific and not a student operating recipe.

2. Fatty-acid separation and glycerol sweet water—E02–E04

The fatty-acid-rich phase is separated from the aqueous glycerol-rich sweet water. Fatty acids are purified, commonly with appropriate vacuum distillation/finishing, to obtain colour and composition suitable for soap. Sweet water goes to glycerin recovery. Glycerol originates in cleavage of the original triglyceride, not from the later neutralisation of already isolated fatty acids.

3. Continuous neutralisation—E05

Purified fatty acids and metered NaOH solution contact in a continuous mixing/reacting unit. Acid-base reaction forms sodium soap and water; control of flow ratio limits free fatty acid or free caustic. The broad syllabus heading may call this soap-making section saponification, but chemically fatty-acid neutralisation differs from direct ester saponification. Both reaction equations are therefore kept separate.

4. Drying and bar finishing—E06–E08

Vacuum drying reduces water to the specified soap-base condition without unnecessarily severe heating. Additives are blended into the cooled/conditioned base and milling homogenises it. The plodder compacts/extrudes the mass; cutting and stamping give finished bars. Perfume and heat-sensitive additives are introduced at an appropriate cool finishing stage rather than into the high-pressure splitting tower.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control feed cleanliness, splitting completeness, acid purity, NaOH metering, moisture and free alkali. Keep sweet-water recovery separate from fatty-acid neutralisation. The next sheet explains true direct triglyceride saponification as the second syllabus route.

Applications / uses

Toilet/laundry bars and suitable formulated cleaning soaps; fatty-acid composition controls hardness, lather and wear behaviour.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Continuous-hydrolysis soap routeમાં પહેલા fatમાંથી fatty acids તથા glycerol બને છે; પછી purified fatty acidsને alkaliથી neutralise કરીને soap મળે છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Pretreated fats/oils, water/steam, NaOH solution તથા permitted finishing additives લેવાય છે.

Triglyceride + 3H2O ⇌ glycerol + 3RCOOH; RCOOH + NaOH → RCOONa + H2O.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Fat preparation તથા Continuous splitting—E01–E02

Fats/oilsને filter/condition કરીને dirt તથા unsuitable impurities દૂર થાય છે. Continuous splitting towerમાં hot water, fat સાથે જરૂરી pressure હેઠળ contact કરે છે,જેથી intended liquid system જળવાય. Hydrolysis ester bonds તોડી fatty acids તથા glycerol આપે છે. Industrial high-pressure splitting ઘણી વાર લગભગ250°C તથા several MPa પર વર્ણવાય છે,પણ actual conditions design-specific છે,student operating recipe નહીં.

2. Fatty-acid separation તથા Glycerol sweet water—E02–E04

Fatty-acid-rich phase aqueous glycerol-rich sweet waterથી જુદું પડે છે. Fatty acidsને યોગ્ય vacuum distillation/finishingથી soap માટે જરૂરી colour/composition સુધી purify કરાય છે. Sweet water glycerin recoveryમાં જાય છે. Glycerol મૂળ triglyceride cleavageથી બને છે,પહેલેથી અલગ fatty acidsના પાછળના neutralisationથી નહીં.

3. Continuous neutralisation—E05

Purified fatty acids તથા metered NaOH continuous mixing/reacting unitમાં મળે છે. Acid-base reactionથી sodium soap તથા water બને છે; flow ratioથી free fatty acid/free caustic મર્યાદિત થાય છે. Broad syllabus headingમાં soap-makingને saponification કહેવાય,પરંતુ chemically fatty-acid neutralisation direct ester saponificationથી જુદું છે. તેથી બંને equations અલગ આપ્યાં છે.

4. Drying તથા Bar finishing—E06–E08

Vacuum dryingથી બિનજરૂરી harsh heating વગર soap-baseનું water specification મળે છે. Cooled/conditioned baseમાં additives blend/mill કરીને uniformity મળે છે. Plodder massને compact/extrude કરે છે; cutting/stampingથી bars મળે છે. Perfume તથા heat-sensitive additives યોગ્ય cool finishingમાં ઉમેરાય છે,high-pressure splitting towerમાં નહીં.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Feed cleanliness, splitting completeness, acid purity, NaOH metering, moisture તથા free alkali નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Sweet-water recoveryને fatty-acid neutralisationથી જુદું રાખવું. આગળની sheet syllabusની બીજી route તરીકે સાચું direct triglyceride saponification સમજાવે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Toilet/laundry bars તથા formulated cleaning soaps; fatty-acid compositionથી hardness, lather તથા wear behaviour નક્કી થાય છે.

body.en:
Definition

Direct saponification hydrolyses triglyceride esters with alkali to form soap and glycerol in the same reaction system.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Pretreated fats/oils, NaOH solution and suitable brine/washing media where the separation process uses them.

Triglyceride + 3NaOH → glycerol + 3RCOONa.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Continuous reaction and soap/lye separation—E01–E03

Prepared fat and metered alkali enter the continuous saponifier, where mixing and heat provide contact between the phases. Ester cleavage forms sodium fatty-acid salts and glycerol. The downstream separator divides the soap-rich phase from glycerol-containing aqueous lye; controlled electrolyte/brine use assists separation in the selected process. This route reacts alkali with fat directly, unlike the preceding isolated-fatty-acid route.

2. Soap washing, drying and finishing—E04–E07

Washing/adjustment removes excess lye and controls soap composition. Vacuum drying sets moisture; additive blending/milling and plodding/cutting/stamping produce finished soap. Free alkali, unsaponified matter and moisture are checked against grade. Excess NaOH is not a desirable way to claim stronger soap:it can make the product harsh and unsafe.

3. Spent-lye concentration and glycerol recovery—E08–E10

The aqueous lye contains glycerol, water, salts and impurities. Concentration precipitates salt, which is removed before final glycerol purification. Suitable clarification, evaporation and vacuum distillation are then required to recover purified glycerin. Spent soap lye needs salt management and is not compositionally identical to the comparatively salt-lean sweet water from water-only fat splitting.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control alkali/fat ratio, phase separation, salt balance, free caustic and wash-water losses. Do not state that only water is needed for direct saponification; water-only fat splitting is hydrolysis.

Applications / uses

Soap products and recovered glycerin co-product, after suitable purification.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Alkaliથી triglyceride estersનું hydrolysis કરીને એ જ reaction systemમાં soap તથા glycerol બનાવવું એટલે direct saponification.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Pretreated fats/oils, NaOH solution તથા separation process મુજબ suitable brine/washing media લેવાય છે.

Triglyceride + 3NaOH → glycerol + 3RCOONa.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Continuous reaction તથા Soap/Lye separation—E01–E03

Prepared fat તથા metered alkali continuous saponifierમાં જાય છે; mixing/heatથી phases contact કરે છે. Ester cleavageથી sodium fatty-acid salts તથા glycerol બને છે. Separator soap-rich phaseને glycerol-containing aqueous lyeથી જુદું કરે છે; selected processમાં controlled electrolyte/brine separationને મદદ કરે છે. આ routeમાં alkali સીધું fat સાથે react કરે છે,પાછલી isolated-fatty-acid route જેવી નથી.

2. Soap washing, drying તથા Finishing—E04–E07

Washing/adjustment excess lye દૂર કરીને soap composition નિયંત્રિત કરે છે. Vacuum dryingથી moisture મળે છે; additive blending/milling તથા plodding/cutting/stampingથી finished soap બને છે. Free alkali, unsaponified matter તથા moisture grade પ્રમાણે ચકાસાય છે. વધારે NaOHને stronger soapનો લાભ માનવો નહીં; product harsh/unsafe બની શકે છે.

3. Spent-lye concentration તથા Glycerol recovery—E08–E10

Aqueous lyeમાં glycerol, water, salts તથા impurities હોય છે. Concentrationથી salt precipitate થાય છે; final purification પહેલાં દૂર કરાય છે. પછી યોગ્ય clarification, evaporation તથા vacuum distillationથી purified glycerin મળે છે. Spent soap lyeમાં salt management જરૂરી છે; તે water-only fat splittingના comparatively salt-lean sweet water જેવું નથી.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Alkali/fat ratio, phase separation, salt balance, free caustic તથા wash-water losses નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Direct saponification માટે ફક્ત water પૂરતું છે એવું ન કહેવું; water-only fat splitting hydrolysis છે.

ઉપયોગો

Soap products તથા યોગ્ય purification પછી recovered glycerin co-product.

body.en:
Definition

Linear alkylbenzene(LAB) is benzene bearing a predominantly linear alkyl chain and is an intermediate for biodegradable alkylbenzene-sulphonate detergents.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Clean benzene, linear olefin feed commonly in the detergent-range carbon numbers and a suitable solid-acid catalyst. Upstream paraffin dehydrogenation is outside this selected battery limit.

C6H6 + C12H24(linear-olefin example) → C18H30(LAB example). Commercial LAB is a chain/isomer mixture, not one pure dodecylbenzene.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Feed preparation and alkylation—E01–E02

Benzene and the linear-olefin stream are purified/dried as required by the catalyst and passed through the controlled alkylation system. The acid catalyst promotes attachment of the alkyl group to the aromatic ring while feed ratio and temperature limit multiple alkylation and heavy by-products. Excess benzene can improve selectivity and is recovered downstream. The selected solid-acid route is not the historical HF/AlCl3 route.

2. Benzene and light/paraffin recovery—E03–E04

Distillation first removes unreacted benzene for purification/recycle. A separate light/paraffin separation removes material outside the LAB product cut, including paraffins carried with an industrial olefin feed. These recycle/separation duties are physical operations, not sulphonation. Benzene containment is important because it is a toxic volatile feed.

3. LAB finishing—E05–E06

Finishing distillation separates the required LAB range from heavy alkylates. The product is cooled/stored for transfer to a detergent-intermediate plant. LAB has an aromatic ring and a hydrophobic alkyl chain but no ionic sulphonate head; it becomes the LAS surfactant only after sulphonation and neutralisation. Linearity improves biodegradation relative to heavily branched historical alkylbenzene, but does not make untreated discharge acceptable.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control olefin purity, catalyst condition, heat removal, benzene recycle and heavy formation. Do not replace linear olefin with a branched feed while still calling the product linear LAB.

Applications / uses

Main feedstock for linear alkylbenzene sulphonic acid/LAS in detergent powders and liquids.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

મુખ્યત્વે linear alkyl chain ધરાવતું benzene LAB છે; તે alkylbenzene-sulphonate detergentsનું intermediate છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Clean benzene,સામાન્ય detergent-range carbon numbersનું linear olefin feed તથા suitable solid-acid catalyst લેવાય છે. Upstream paraffin dehydrogenation આ selected battery limitની બહાર છે.

C6H6 + C12H24(linear-olefin example) → C18H30(LAB example). Commercial LAB is a chain/isomer mixture, not one pure dodecylbenzene.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Feed preparation તથા Alkylation—E01–E02

Benzene તથા linear-olefin stream catalyst મુજબ purify/dry થઈ controlled alkylationમાં જાય છે. Acid catalyst alkyl groupને aromatic ring પર જોડે છે; feed ratio/temperatureથી multiple alkylation તથા heavy by-products ઘટે છે. Excess benzene selectivityમાં મદદ કરે છે અને આગળ recover થાય છે. Selected solid-acid route historical HF/AlCl3 route નથી.

2. Benzene તથા Light/Paraffin recovery—E03–E04

Distillation unreacted benzeneને purification/recycle માટે કાઢે છે. Separate light/paraffin separation LAB cutની બહારનું material,જેમાં industrial olefin feedના paraffins પણ હોય શકે,દૂર કરે છે. આ physical operations છે,sulphonation નહીં. Benzene toxic volatile feed હોવાથી containment મહત્વનું છે.

3. LAB finishing—E05–E06

Finishing distillation જરૂરી LAB rangeને heavy alkylatesથી જુદી કરે છે. Product cool/store થઈ detergent-intermediate plantમાં જાય છે. LABમાં aromatic ring તથા hydrophobic alkyl chain છે,પણ ionic sulphonate head નથી; sulphonation/neutralisation પછી જ LAS surfactant બને છે. Heavily branched historical alkylbenzene કરતાં linearity biodegradation સુધારે છે,પરંતુ untreated discharge યોગ્ય બનાવતી નથી.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Olefin purity, catalyst condition, heat removal, benzene recycle તથા heavy formation નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Branched feed વાપરીને productને linear LAB કહેવું નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

Detergent powders/liquidsના linear alkylbenzene sulphonic acid/LAS માટે મુખ્ય feedstock.

notes.reaction_summary: C6H6 + C12H24(linear-olefin example) → C18H30(LAB example). Commercial LAB is a chain/isomer mixture,not one pure dodecylbenzene.

body.en:
Definition

The selected powder process makes an LAS surfactant by sulphonating LAB and neutralising the acid, then formulates and spray-dries a detergent slurry.

Raw materials and reaction principle

LAB, controlled SO3/air system, process water, NaOH, builders/fillers and suitable post-dosed additives.

R–C6H5 + SO3 → R–C6H4–SO3H(LABSA); LABSA + NaOH → R–C6H4–SO3Na(LAS) + H2O.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Sulphonation and conditioning—E01–E02

LAB contacts the controlled SO3/air stream in a purpose-designed, cooled sulphonation reactor, commonly a film-contacting arrangement. Heat removal limits darkening and undesirable side reactions. Ageing/hydrolysis conditioning completes the desired acid product and manages reactive by-products under the plant’s controlled system. This unit creates the sulphonic-acid head group; it does not yet produce the final formulated powder.

2. Neutralisation and slurry formulation—E03–E04

The acid is neutralised with metered NaOH to produce sodium LAS. A crutcher/slurry mixer combines surfactant with water and selected builders, filler and other heat-compatible ingredients. Builders assist hardness control and wash performance; fillers mainly adjust handling/solids and should not be described as the active surfactant. Formulation targets the intended wash conditions and applicable ingredient limits.

3. Spray drying and dust recovery—E05/E09

The slurry is atomised into hot drying air; water evaporates and porous detergent granules form. Exhaust passes through suitable dust recovery, with compatible fines returned to the slurry circuit. The dryer gives particle structure and moisture control, it does not replace surfactant chemistry. Air/dust management limits emissions and product loss.

4. Cooling, post-dosing and packing—E06–E08

Powder is cooled/classified before blending with heat-sensitive ingredients such as perfume, enzymes or bleach systems where the formulation uses them. These additives are not intentionally exposed to the hottest sulphonation/slurry stages. Finished powder is checked for active matter, moisture, bulk density, flow and wash performance, then packed against moisture uptake.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control SO3 contact/heat removal, neutralisation pH, slurry viscosity, dryer moisture, dust and additive compatibility. Some modern powders use agglomeration rather than this spray-drying route; do not silently substitute the equipment.

Applications / uses

Laundry and suitable household/industrial cleaning powders with grade-specific ingredients.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

LAB sulphonation તથા acid neutralisationથી LAS surfactant બનાવી,slurry formulate/spray-dry કરીને detergent powder બનાવવાની selected process છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

LAB, controlled SO3/air system, process water, NaOH, builders/fillers તથા suitable post-dosed additives લેવાય છે.

R–C6H5 + SO3 → R–C6H4–SO3H(LABSA); LABSA + NaOH → R–C6H4–SO3Na(LAS) + H2O.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Sulphonation તથા Conditioning—E01–E02

LAB purpose-designed, cooled sulphonation reactorમાં controlled SO3/air સાથે contact કરે છે; ઘણી વાર film-contacting arrangement હોય છે. Heat removalથી darkening તથા side reactions ઘટે છે. Controlled ageing/hydrolysis conditioningથી desired acid product પૂર્ણ થાય છે અને reactive by-products manage થાય છે. આ unit sulphonic-acid head group બનાવે છે,હજી formulated powder નહીં.

2. Neutralisation તથા Slurry formulation—E03–E04

Acid metered NaOHથી neutralise થઈ sodium LAS આપે છે. Crutcher/slurry mixerમાં surfactant સાથે water, selected builders, filler તથા heat-compatible ingredients મળે છે. Builders hardness control/wash performanceમાં મદદ કરે છે; fillers મુખ્યત્વે handling/solids બદલે છે,active surfactant નથી. Formulation wash conditions તથા applicable ingredient limits મુજબ થાય છે.

3. Spray drying તથા Dust recovery—E05/E09

Slurry hot drying airમાં atomise થાય છે; water evaporate થતાં porous granules બને છે. Exhaust dust recoveryમાં જાય છે અને compatible fines slurry circuitમાં પાછાં આવે છે. Dryer particle structure તથા moisture control આપે છે,surfactant chemistryનો વિકલ્પ નથી. Air/dust management emissions/product loss ઘટાડે છે.

4. Cooling, post-dosing તથા Packing—E06–E08

Powder cool/classify થયા પછી formulation મુજબ perfume, enzymes અથવા bleach systems જેવા heat-sensitive ingredients blend થાય છે. તેમને hottest sulphonation/slurry stagesમાં જાણે કરીને મુકાતાં નથી. Active matter, moisture, bulk density, flow તથા wash performance ચકાસીને moisture uptake સામે pack કરાય છે.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

SO3 contact/heat removal, neutralisation pH, slurry viscosity, dryer moisture, dust તથા additive compatibility નિયંત્રિત કરવાં. કેટલાક modern powders agglomerationથી બને છે,પરંતુ અહીં spray-drying route છે; equipmentને જાણે સમાન હોય તેમ બદલી ન દેવું.

ઉપયોગો

Grade-specific ingredients મુજબ laundry તથા household/industrial cleaning powdersમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Definition

Glycerin recovery separates and purifies glycerol already formed during fat splitting or saponification; the main drawing uses fat-splitting sweet water.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Aqueous glycerol sweet water and approved clarification/treatment media. Spent soap lye is an alternative feed needing additional salt management.

Upstream formation:triglyceride + 3H2O → glycerol + 3fatty acids. Downstream clarification/evaporation/distillation are separations, not a new glycerol-forming reaction.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Clarification and impurity removal—E01–E03

Sweet water is collected and clarified to remove entrained fatty matter and suspended solids. Controlled neutralisation/chemical treatment conditions the feed, followed by filtration of precipitated/insoluble impurities. The treatment is chosen for the actual feed analysis; adding arbitrary acid/base is not a universal purification recipe. If the feed is spent lye, salt and soap impurities need the dedicated handling shown in the saponification alternative.

2. Vacuum concentration—E04

Evaporation removes much of the water and raises glycerol concentration before final distillation. Vacuum reduces the boiling temperature and thermal exposure; water vapour is condensed/managed separately. Concentration alone leaves nonvolatile salts and colour bodies in the liquid, so a concentrated crude stream is not automatically high-purity glycerin.

3. Vacuum distillation, polishing and storage—E05–E07

Under controlled vacuum, glycerol is distilled away from less-volatile residue while limiting thermal degradation. Suitable fraction control separates undesirable light/heavy impurities. Colour polishing with approved treatment and final filtration produces the specified grade. Dry, compatible storage limits water uptake because glycerol is hygroscopic. Grade release requires actual analysis rather than an assumed purity based only on colour.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control feed salts, foaming, vacuum, temperature, colour, water content and trace contaminants. Overheating/dehydration can create hazardous degradation products; crude glycerin must not be used as food/medicine without compliant purification/testing.

Applications / uses

Approved humectant/solvent grades for personal care, pharmaceutical/food use and technical grades for resins/chemical manufacture.

વ્યાખ્યા

Fat splitting અથવા saponificationમાં પહેલેથી બનેલા glycerolને અલગ/purify કરવું એટલે glycerin recovery; મુખ્ય drawing fat-splitting sweet water માટે છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Aqueous glycerol sweet water તથા approved clarification/treatment media લેવાય છે. Spent soap lye alternative છે,જેમાં extra salt management જોઈએ.

Upstream formation:triglyceride + 3H2O → glycerol + 3fatty acids. Downstream clarification/evaporation/distillation are separations, not a new glycerol-forming reaction.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Clarification તથા Impurity removal—E01–E03

Sweet water collect/clarify કરીને entrained fatty matter તથા suspended solids દૂર થાય છે. Controlled neutralisation/chemical treatment પછી precipitated/insoluble impurities filter થાય છે. Treatment actual feed analysis પ્રમાણે નક્કી થાય છે; મનસ્વી acid/base addition universal recipe નથી. Spent lye હોય તો saponification alternative મુજબ dedicated salt/soap impurity management જોઈએ.

2. Vacuum concentration—E04

Evaporation ઘણું water દૂર કરીને final distillation પહેલાં glycerol concentration વધારે છે. Vacuum boiling temperature તથા thermal exposure ઘટાડે છે; water vapour અલગ condense/manage થાય છે. Concentration પછી પણ nonvolatile salts/colour bodies liquidમાં રહે છે,એટલે concentrated crude stream આપમેળે high-purity glycerin નથી.

3. Vacuum distillation, polishing તથા Storage—E05–E07

Controlled vacuumમાં glycerol less-volatile residueથી distil થાય છે અને thermal degradation મર્યાદિત રહે છે. Suitable fraction control undesirable light/heavy impurities અલગ કરે છે. Approved colour polishing તથા final filtrationથી specified grade મળે છે. Glycerol hygroscopic હોવાથી dry, compatible storage water uptake ઘટાડે છે. Grade release માટે actual analysis જોઈએ,ફક્ત colour પરથી purity માની ન લેવાય.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Feed salts, foaming, vacuum, temperature, colour, water તથા trace contaminants નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Overheating/dehydrationથી hazardous degradation products બની શકે છે; compliant purification/testing વગર crude glycerin food/medicineમાં વાપરવું નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

Approved humectant/solvent grades personal care, pharmaceutical/food ઉપયોગમાં તથા technical grades resins/chemical manufactureમાં વપરાય છે.

Alkaline hydrolysis of fat forms soap and glycerol. Student-scale preparation follows the assigned fat/alkali SOP, not industrial high-pressure splitting.

Apparatus and approved materials

Instructor-approved enclosed/fume-hood setup, compatible vessel and controls, measurement equipment and only the materials listed in the actual institutional SOP. Portfolioમાં genuine permitted photographs/videos, survey/library records તથા team roles ઉમેરો. Date, names, prices, visits તથા signatures ખરેખર મેળવ્યા વગર ભરવાં નહીં. આ planning template છે,activity performedનો પુરાવો નથી.

body.en:
Illustrative calculation with stated hypothetical data; not an actual practical result.

Given

100kg pure triolein; complete hydrolysis; M(triolein)=885.45kg/kmol; M(glycerol)=92.09kg/kmol; one mole triolein yields one mole glycerol.

Find and formula

Find theoretical glycerol formed:mG=mtriolein×92.09/885.45.

Substitution and calculation

mG=100×92.09/885.45=10.4004kg.

Final answer and check

Theoretical glycerol≈10.40kg. This is pure glycerol formed, not sweet-water mass or a measured recovery. Recovery efficiency and feed purity would need separate factors.

શોધવું તથા સૂત્ર

body.en:
Triglyceride + 3H2O ⇌ glycerol + 3RCOOH; RCOOH + NaOH → RCOONa + H2O.

Triglyceride + 3NaOH → glycerol + 3RCOONa.

C6H6 + C12H24(linear-olefin example) → C18H30(LAB example). Commercial LAB is a chain/isomer mixture,not one pure dodecylbenzene.

R–C6H5 + SO3 → R–C6H4–SO3H(LABSA); LABSA + NaOH → R–C6H4–SO3Na(LAS) + H2O.

Upstream formation:triglyceride + 3H2O → glycerol + 3fatty acids. Downstream clarification/evaporation/distillation are separations,not a new glycerol-forming reaction.

title.en: How to study a manufacturing answer

body.en: State the product and route,raw materials and reaction;draw the correctly labelled flowsheet;explain each stage in arrow order with recycle/by-products;finish with key controls and uses. Equipment in original supplied scans must be identified by their printed names;E-numbers refer only to new study redraws.
body.gu: Product/route,raw materials તથા reaction લખો;સાચી labelled flowsheet દોરો;arrow order મુજબ દરેક stage તથા recycle/by-products સમજાવો;છેલ્લે key controls/uses આપો. મૂળ scansના equipmentને તેમના printed namesથી ઓળખો;E numbers ફક્ત નવા study redraws માટે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Soap—definition,cleaning action and uses.
q.gu: સાબુ—વ્યાખ્યા,Cleaning action તથા ઉપયોગોની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Soap is a sodium or potassium salt of a higher fatty acid; it is an anionic surfactant.
a.gu: Higher fatty acidનું sodium અથવા potassium salt એટલે soap; તે anionic surfactant છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Detergent—definition,types and uses.

a.en: A synthetic detergent is a cleaning formulation based on surfactants which need not be fatty-acid salts; commercial detergent powder also contains builders and other functional ingredients.
a.gu: Fatty-acid salts હોવું જરૂરી ન હોય એવા surfactants આધારિત cleaning formulation એટલે synthetic detergent; commercial powderમાં builders તથા બીજા functional ingredients પણ હોય છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Glycerin—definition,properties and uses.

a.en: Glycerol, C3H8O3,is propane-1,2,3-triol; glycerin is the commercial name commonly used for glycerol-containing grades.
a.gu: Glycerol, C3H8O3 એટલે propane-1,2,3-triol; glycerol-containing commercial grades માટે glycerin નામ વપરાય છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Soap—continuous hydrolysis route.

a.en: The continuous-hydrolysis soap route first splits fats into fatty acids and glycerol, then neutralises purified fatty acids with alkali to form soap.
a.gu: Continuous-hydrolysis soap routeમાં પહેલા fatમાંથી fatty acids તથા glycerol બને છે; પછી purified fatty acidsને alkaliથી neutralise કરીને soap મળે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Soap—direct saponification alternative.

a.en: Direct saponification hydrolyses triglyceride esters with alkali to form soap and glycerol in the same reaction system.
a.gu: Alkaliથી triglyceride estersનું hydrolysis કરીને એ જ reaction systemમાં soap તથા glycerol બનાવવું એટલે direct saponification.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Linear alkylbenzene—LAB.

a.en: Linear alkylbenzene(LAB) is benzene bearing a predominantly linear alkyl chain and is an intermediate for biodegradable alkylbenzene-sulphonate detergents.
a.gu: મુખ્યત્વે linear alkyl chain ધરાવતું benzene LAB છે; તે alkylbenzene-sulphonate detergentsનું intermediate છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Detergent powder.

a.en: The selected powder process makes an LAS surfactant by sulphonating LAB and neutralising the acid, then formulates and spray-dries a detergent slurry.
a.gu: LAB sulphonation તથા acid neutralisationથી LAS surfactant બનાવી,slurry formulate/spray-dry કરીને detergent powder બનાવવાની selected process છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Glycerin manufacture/recovery.
q.gu: ગ્લિસરિનનું ઉત્પાદન તથા Recoveryની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Glycerin recovery separates and purifies glycerol already formed during fat splitting or saponification; the main drawing uses fat-splitting sweet water.
a.gu: Fat splitting અથવા saponificationમાં પહેલેથી બનેલા glycerolને અલગ/purify કરવું એટલે glycerin recovery; મુખ્ય drawing fat-splitting sweet water માટે છે.

q.en: Define soap,detergent and glycerin and state their uses.
Distinguish fatty-acid neutralisation from direct triglyceride saponification.
q.gu: Fatty-acid neutralisation તથા direct triglyceride saponificationનો ભેદ આપો.

q.en: Explain continuous fat hydrolysis and soap finishing with glycerol sweet-water recovery.
q.gu: Glycerol sweet-water recovery સાથે continuous fat hydrolysis તથા soap finishing સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain direct soap saponification and the spent-lye recovery path.
q.gu: Direct soap saponification તથા spent-lye recovery path સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain LAB manufacture by the selected linear-olefin/benzene route with recycle.
q.gu: Selected linear-olefin/benzene routeથી recycle સાથે LAB manufacture સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain detergent powder manufacture from LAB,including post-dosing and dust recovery.
q.gu: Post-dosing તથા dust recovery સાથે LABમાંથી detergent powder manufacture સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain glycerin recovery and distinguish sweet water from spent soap lye.
q.gu: Glycerin recovery સમજાવો તથા sweet water/spent soap lyeનો ભેદ આપો.
